title: 第9章 城隍有请第10章 下凡文曲星的私会
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
“咚咚咚！”
就在知白准备呼呼大睡时，房门却被敲响。
“知白。”
“公子，怎么了？”
知白急忙下床，打开房门。
“我准备去城外一趟，你去吗？”
知白也没问纪风去城外干什么，只是答道：“去！”
城北五里，一座秃山，山脚下密密麻麻全是坟包。
有的有碑，有的没碑，有的连坟包都没有，就一个坑。
“公子，你是来找昨晚那女子的？”
纪风应道：“嗯，在我们老家那边，信奉入土为安，逝者的灵魂才能得到安息。”
“奥奥，知道了。”
知白走在前头，一个坟包一个坟包看过去。
“公子，哪个是？”
纪风也不知道。
他脑子中回想文判说过的话：
“张氏，夫病故，被主家强纳为妾，不从，遭毒打致死，死后葬于乱葬岗。”
但没写具体位置。
他站在乱葬岗边上，看着那一大片坟包。
闭上眼，再睁开时，眼球已变成了灰白色。

在阴阳法眼之下，山川河流，草木金石，都成虚幻，无数骸骨在眼前浮现。
“在这儿。”
纪风盯着一具骸骨，往里走去。
到头则是一袭草帘，连坟包都没有，也难怪会变成厉鬼。
不一会儿，一座新坟出现。
“知白，我们走吧。”
“公子，完事了？”
纪风点点头：“嗯，我们能做的也就只有这么多了。”
回到听雨轩，就在纪风准备推门而入时，旁边小院的门开了。
旁边小院和听雨轩简直不能比，只有一间茅草房，还破破烂烂的。
出来个年轻人，二十出头。
穿这件洗得发白的青色长衫，袖口都磨出了毛边。
人很瘦，脸色发黄，像是常年吃不饱饭的样子，行色匆匆，就要往外走去。
似乎察觉到有目光注视着他，年轻人向纪风和知白望过来。
“见过公子和小童，二位是新搬来的？”
纪风点点头：“在下纪风。”
又指了指知白：“这是我的道童，叫知白。”
年轻人急忙回礼道：“在下姓苏，名文远，字明之，是个书生。”
content_en:
"Dong dong dong!"
Just when Zhibai was about to fall asleep, there was a knock on the door.
"Zhibai."
"Sir, what's wrong?"
Zhibai hurriedly got out of bed and opened the door.
"I'm going to go outside the city, will you go?"
Zhibai didn't ask Ji Feng what he was doing outside the city, and just replied: "Go!"
Five miles north of the city, there is a bald mountain, and the foot of the mountain is densely packed with tombs.
Some have monuments, some don't, and some don't even have graves, just a pit.
"Sir, are you here to see the woman from last night?"
Ji Feng responded: "Well, in our hometown, we believe that only when the deceased is buried in the ground can the soul of the deceased rest in peace."
"Aoao, I got it."
Zhibai walked in front, looking at the graves one by one.
"Sir, which one is it?"
Ji Feng doesn’t know either.
He recalled in his mind what Judge Wen had said:
"Mr. Zhang, her husband died of illness. She was taken as a concubine by the master's family. She refused and was beaten to death. After her death, she was buried in a mass grave."
But the specific location was not written.
He stood at the edge of the mass grave and looked at the large mass of graves.
When he closed his eyes and opened them again, his eyeballs had turned gray-white.
Under the eyes of yin and yang, mountains, rivers, vegetation, gold and stones all became illusions, and countless skeletons appeared before their eyes.
"Here."
Ji Feng stared at a skeleton and walked inside.
In the end, he was dressed in a straw curtain and didn't even have a grave. It's no wonder he turned into a ghost.
After a while, a new tomb appeared.
"Zhibai, let's go."
"Sir, are you done?"
Ji Feng nodded: "Well, there's only so much we can do."
Back at Tingyuxuan, just when Ji Feng was about to push the door open and enter, the door to the small courtyard next to him opened.
The small courtyard next to it is incomparable to Tingyuxuan. It only has a thatched house, which is in tatters.
A young man came out, in his early twenties.
Wearing this cyan gown that had been washed white, the cuffs were frayed.
The man was very thin and his face was sallow, as if he had not had enough to eat all year round. He was in a hurry and was about to go out.
As if aware that someone was watching him, the young man looked towards Ji Feng and Zhibai.
"I've met the young master and the little boy. Are you two newly moved here?"
Ji Feng nodded: "Ji Feng."
Then he pointed at Zhibai and said, "This is my Taoist boy, his name is Zhibai."
The young man hurriedly replied: "My surname is Su, my given name is Wenyuan, my courtesy name is Mingzhi, and I am a scholar."
